visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two anthropomorphic feline creatures with human-like black bob hairstyles are seated at wooden desks in a classroom, viewed from behind. They wear white and navy blue sailor-style school uniforms. The creature in the foreground reaches out with its furry paw and taps the shoulder of the creature seated in front. (2) The creature in the front row raises its right paw high into the air, while the creature in the back row lowers its arm and rests its tail on the seat. The background shows a green chalkboard with white text and a brightly lit classroom. (3) The creature in the back row suddenly reaches forward and forcefully taps or hits the back of the front creature's head. The front creature's head jerks forward slightly from the impact. (4) The front creature raises its paw again, seemingly to get the attention of someone off-camera, while the back creature sits still. The lighting remains bright and even throughout the scene.
